artifact.self_contained_problem: Decide whether the following parameterized problem is fixed-parameter tractable. Directed Feedback Vertex Set: given a directed graph G = (V, E) and a positive integer k (the parameter), determine whether there exists a set S ⊆ V with |S| ≤ k such that every directed cycle of G contains at least one vertex of S. Equivalently, the question is whether there is an algorithm deciding this problem in time f(k) · |V|^{O(1)} for some computable function f depending only on k.
artifact.category_tag: Parameterized complexity / Directed Feedback Vertex Set
artifact.status_search_result: Chen, Liu, Lu, O'Sullivan, and Razgon (STOC 2008; J. ACM 2008) proved that Directed Feedback Vertex Set is fixed-parameter tractable, giving an algorithm with running time O(4^k k! · n^{O(1)}). Subsequent works have improved the running time (e.g., a linear-time parameterized algorithm and simplified variants). Thus the FPT question is resolved affirmatively; whether DFVS admits a polynomial kernel remains open.
